feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 2 September 2026 5:30am
items.description:
##Yesterday##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

SW soon backing S or SE 3 or 4, veering SW this afternoon, then W or SW 4 or 5 tonight.


##State of sea)##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate later today.


##Weather)##

Spells of rain, some mist for a time, becoming mostly fair mid to late afternoon onwards.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or mist.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 15°C and max. air temperature 18°C
##Sea Temperature##

16°C
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong wind at times.


##Wind)##

W or SW 4 or 5, occasionally 6, backing S or SW 3 or 4 for a while at night.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Mainly fair, then rain arriving in the evening, becoming mostly fair late in the night.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 17°C
##Sea Temperature##

16°C

##Warnings)##

Strong wind.


##Wind)##

W or SW 4 or 5 soon increasing 5 or 6, decreasing 3 or 4 later.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Soon mainly fair.


##Visibility)##

Good.

16°C

##Warnings)##

Nil.

W 3 or 4, gradually backing S or SE, 4 or 5 later.

Slight, becoming slight or moderate later.

Fair, then rain arriving overnight.

Good, occasionally moderate in rain later.

16°C

##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

Slight or moderate, soon becoming moderate or rough, then falling slight or moderate overnight.


##Weather)##
